thread.title: Trump responds to Apple tariff concerns, suggests 'easy solution' - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Trump responds to Apple tariff concerns, suggests 'easy solution' - MarketWatch
text: President Donald Trump on Saturday appeared to respond to Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -0.81% letter concerning the impact that proposed tariffs could have on the Apple Watch, AirPods, and other products. "Apple prices may increase because of the massive Tariffs we may be imposing on China - but there is an easy solution where there would be ZERO tax, and indeed a tax incentive," he wrote on Twitter. "Make your products in the United States instead of China." He urged Apple to "start building new plants now" and ended his message with: "Exciting!" Apple on Wednesday sent a letter to the U.S. trade representative saying that a proposed 25% tariff on $200 billion worth of goods imported from China would affect numerous Apple products, including the Watch, Mac Mini, and charging cables. "Our concern with these tariffs is that the U.S. will be hardest hit, and that will result in lower U.S. growth and competitiveness and higher prices for U.S. consumers," the company said in the letter. Apple's stock closed down 0.8% in Friday's session, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.31% fell 0.3%.
